baseUrl.description: Legacy editor value used to enable repository selection. Set the top-level URL for the connection.

dataLinks.description: Add links to string fields in log row details.

datasourceUid.description: UID of a Grafana data source. When set, the derived data link is treated as an internal link to that data source and the URL field is interpreted as a Query.

field.description: Exact name of a string field in the log result.

matcherRegex.description: Regular expression applied to the field value. The first capture group supplies the link value.

url.description: External URL or query for an internal data source link.

defaultRepository.description: Repository to use when a query has no repository. In NGSIEM mode the editor selects search-all by default.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Use the secure SOCKS proxy when it is enabled on the Grafana server.

httpHeaders.description: Additional headers for LogScale API requests. Store the first name in jsonData.httpHeaderName1 and its value in secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue1. Increment the index for each additional header.

incrementalQueryOverlapWindow.description: Time to re-fetch on each incremental query to include late events. Save and reload the data source to apply changes.

incrementalQuerying.description: On auto-refresh, fetch new data and merge it with cached results for relative time ranges without aggregation functions.

keepCookies.description: Cookies, by name, that the Grafana proxy should forward to the datasource. The Grafana proxy strips all cookies by default.

mode.description: Use LogScale for a LogScale instance or NGSIEM for Falcon Next-Gen SIEM.

oauth2.description: Enable OAuth2 client credentials for NGSIEM.

oauth2ClientId.description: Client ID for the CrowdStrike API.

oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user's OAuth identity to LogScale.

serverName.description: Server name used for TLS SNI / certificate verification. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ServerName`.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. The SDK defaults to 30 seconds. Streaming requests have no overall timeout.

tlsAuth.description: Send a client certificate and private key for mutual TLS.

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Trust a self-signed certificate or a private certificate authority.

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the server certificate.

url.description: Complete HTTP URL of the datasource (e.g. https://your-server:8080).

secureValues.description: PEM-encoded client certificate used for mTLS. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientCertificate`.
PEM-encoded private key paired with `tlsClientCert`. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientKey`.
Personal token for the LogScale instance.
Client secret for the CrowdStrike API.
